=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:242-249 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Credential-name denylist matches KEY/PAT etc. only as whole underscore-delimited words, so names like SERVICE_SIGNINGKEY pass and are resolved from the environment.
  WHY: Opaque secret values are not caught by the value-shape check, so they can be substituted into a trusted render. Severity disagreement: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT (only trusted templates reach it); the others rated it MAJOR. Highest used.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:207,397 (also tests/test_render_prompt_env_placeholder_guard.py:125-129) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: PR-added comments and test strings contain contiguous credential-like placeholder literals such as `{{GH_TOKEN}}`, `{{GH_PAT}}` and `{{1}}`.
  WHY: A pre-fix staged renderer resolves these from the runner environment when the diff is inlined into reviewer prompts, which leaks a runner value to third-party providers. This is the leak the PR closes.
- changelog.d/9465-render-prompt-env-secret-guard.md:2 | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment embeds contiguous `{{GH_TOKEN}}` and `{{1}}` literals.
  WHY: A pre-fix renderer would substitute the runner PAT into prompts, and the text ships permanently in CHANGELOG.md to consumer repos.
- changelog.d/9465-render-prompt-env-secret-guard.md (second sentence of the body bullet) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog bullet embeds the runtime scratchpad path `/tmp/codex-pr-43470989490-1-15431/reviewer_prompt_body.txt` as its example.
  WHY: The path would be copied verbatim into every consumer's CHANGELOG.md after the fold and sync.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: For trusted templates, read placeholder names only from the original template or its contract's required_vars/optional_vars, never from assembled content.
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.sh (PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE set at lines 298/313; collect_prompt_placeholders at line 413; loop at lines 422-444)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE is still set to ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE and names are still collected from the assembled content, no contract required_vars/optional_vars lookup exists in scripts/render_prompt.sh, and the PR adds name and value denylists instead. Severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR across reviewers.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:207,397 (comments) and tests/test_render_prompt_env_placeholder_guard.py:125-129 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The PR adds contiguous `{{NAME}}` literals naming credential variables, which tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py avoids with its `_brace()` helper.
  WHY: A pre-fix staged renderer resolves them from the runner environment when the diff is embedded in prompts, leaking a runner value to third-party providers.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "For trusted templates, read placeholder names only from the original template or its contract's required_vars/optional_vars, never from assembled content."
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh, PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE (line 313) and collect_prompt_placeholders (line 413)
  Evidence of absence: Trusted renders still collect names from ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE. The PR applies denylists instead. The assembled content is repo-owned, so the leak path is closed, which makes this a partial departure. | severity=NIT | confidence=2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: reword the line 397 comment without braces, and build the test strings with "{{" + name + "}}" (estimated lines changed: 4). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:226-249 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard splits names by underscore but checks only the components against the denylist, not the full name.
  WHY: SERVICE_SIGNINGKEY is a single component that does not match, so it passes and is resolved from the environment.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "For trusted templates, read placeholder names only from the original template or its contract's required_vars/optional_vars, never from assembled content."
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh (placeholder collection logic, lines 413-442)
  Evidence of absence: Names are still collected from ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE, which contains the raw PR diff/content, via collect_prompt_placeholders. There is no contract-driven lookup. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:242-249 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The credential word list is matched only against underscore-delimited tokens, so compound names such as SERVICE_SIGNINGKEY, MYPAT, MYKEY and AUTHTOKEN reach the env lookup.
  WHY: The value-shape check catches only token-shaped values, and the unset of GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_PAT covers only those three names. A trusted prompt naming such a placeholder would substitute the runner's value.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "For trusted templates, read placeholder names only from the original template or its contract's required_vars/optional_vars, never from assembled content."
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh around PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE selection (lines ~299-322) and the following collect_prompt_placeholders call
  Evidence of absence: PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE is ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE whenever assembly runs. No code path reads required_vars/optional_vars from a contract. The PR layers name and value denylists on top instead. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Changelog text should describe the change in user/operator-facing terms, not embed a runtime scratchpad path as the example of "anything that is not a plain identifier".
  Expected change site: changelog.d/9465-render-prompt-env-secret-guard.md (second sentence of the body bullet)
  Evidence of absence: The bullet contains the literal path `/tmp/codex-pr-43470989490-1-15431/reviewer_prompt_body.txt`. The test file was changed to use `{{1}}` but the changelog fragment was not updated. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:242-249, 437-442 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: KEY is matched only as a complete underscore-delimited word (APIKEY is matched separately), so SERVICE_SIGNINGKEY passes the filter.
  WHY: In a trusted render with SERVICE_SIGNINGKEY set, its value is substituted into the prompt, and the value-shape checks do not stop an opaque secret.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "For trusted templates, read placeholder names only from the original template or its contract's required_vars/optional_vars, never from assembled content."
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh, placeholder source selection and collection
  Evidence of absence: Line 313 sets PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE to ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE. For trusted assembled renders the guard does not skip collection, so lines 413 and 422-442 collect and resolve names from it. No collection from only the original template or contract was added. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- changelog.d/9465-render-prompt-env-secret-guard.md:2 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fragment embeds contiguous `{{GH_TOKEN}}` and `{{1}}` literals. The renderer regex at scripts/render_prompt.sh:200 resolves them from the runner environment, and the fix covers only untrusted-flagged bodies.
  WHY: A pass-1 reviewer saw the line arrive substituted with a token-shaped value, and the text ships permanently in CHANGELOG.md to consumers, re-arming the leak class this PR closes. The repo's `_brace()` convention in tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py:306-310 was applied to the tests but not here.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:207,397 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comments contain `{{GH_PAT}}` and `{{GH_TOKEN}}`, the same defect class as the changelog fragment.
  WHY: Until this PR merges, the pre-fix `main` renderer substitutes the exported GH_TOKEN (PAT) into the reviewer prompt and the render_prompt.py argv. A pass-1 reviewer observed this for line 397.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:242-249 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: KEY and PAT are denied only as underscore-delimited whole words, so SERVICE_SIGNINGKEY, APIPAT and MYKEYID pass. The issue's `*KEY*` and `*PAT*` substring forms are not implemented.
  WHY: A trusted template referencing such a name substitutes the env value, and the value-shape guard (lines 257-270) misses opaque secrets. Only repo-authored templates reach this path, so it is a residual gap, not a live exploit.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "For trusted templates, read placeholder names only from the original template or its contract's required_vars/optional_vars, never from assembled content."
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh (PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE at lines 298/313, collect_prompt_placeholders at line 413, loop at lines 422-444)
  Evidence of absence: PLACEHOLDER_SOURCE_FILE is still ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE and no contract lookup exists. The untrusted-body gate and the denylists mitigate the exploit, since assembled content in the trusted path is repo-authored, but the named mechanism was not delivered. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
